ideas.pitch: An edge AI system that performs real-time classification and anomaly detection on optical spectrometer outputs from the UEMK Space Observatory.
ideas.problem_statement: AI & Intelligent Systems: Deploy ultra-low latency neural architectures and computer vision algorithms for real-time sensor intelligence.
ideas.title: AstroSpectra: AI-Powered Astronomical Spectral Line Identifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly ties into the UEMK Space Observatory collaboration and leverages computer vision/classification models proven to win technical hackathons like NeuroForge.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-software prototype transmitting high-speed digital data through modulated LED light sources using Arduino and photodiode receivers.
ideas.problem_statement: Photonics & Optical Innovation: Build real-world solutions using optical sensors, lasers, fiber-optic communication, smart displays, or optical imaging systems.
ideas.title: Li-Fi CommBridge: Low-Latency Optical Wireless Data Link
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the specialized SPIE OPTICA Student Chapter organizer profile by focusing heavily on light-based optical communication rather than generic software.

ideas.pitch: An optical imaging and computer vision tool that detects micro-cracks and busbar failures in solar cells using electroluminescence imaging.
ideas.problem_statement: Photonics & Optical Innovation: Build real-world solutions using optical sensors, lasers, fiber-optic communication, smart displays, solar devices, or optical imaging systems.
ideas.title: SolarCell Vision: Automated Micro-Defect Inspector for Photovoltaic Panels
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines green technology with practical optical imaging, mimicking industrial computer vision pipelines that score high with hardware and domain-expert judges.

ideas.pitch: A low-power mesh network of ESP32 sensor nodes that communicate environmental telemetry offline during network blackouts.
ideas.problem_statement: Robotics & IoT (Hardware Track): Bring hardware to life. Build autonomous robots, smart gadgets, automated control systems, and connected IoT devices.
ideas.title: EdgeMesh IoT: LoRa-Powered Autonomous Environmental Sensor Node
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features robust offline edge networking hardware with a working physical demo, mirroring proven hardware-heavy winners at regional hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A real-time edge application that extracts heart rate and blood oxygen estimations from facial video streams using ambient optical reflections.
ideas.problem_statement: AI & Intelligent Systems: Deploy ultra-low latency neural architectures, computer vision algorithms, and local edge inference models.
ideas.title: OptiScan rPPG: Contactless Vital Signs Monitor via Smartphone Camera
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced signal processing and computer vision running locally on the edge, matching the winning criteria of health-tech and AI fusion tracks.
